name: WEC Energy Group
outlook:
What WEC Energy Group says to expect

  • Full year 2026: earnings per shareLargely due to favorable weather and capital investment supported by the VLCs, the company is raising and narrowing its earnings guidance for 2026 to a range of $5.60 to $5.64 per share. This assumes normal weather for the remainder of the year.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
